amira: Quick Q — I put together a couple of log queries for AP-SG gen route (p95 + kv-cache misses) for the new oncall. Where should I save them so folks can find them quickly?
ben: Two quick options: 1) add snippets to ops/log-searches repo (so they show up in PRs), 2) create saved searches in the Console under Observability -> Saved Queries. Console is best for oncall visibility. Which do you prefer?
morgan: I usually do both: small snippet in Notion/ops/logbook + create a saved search in the Console and link the PR. That way runbook + query are together.
chris: Paste the query and I'll help name/format it and add it to the team folder. Try to include org/model/route/region in the name.
amira: Thanks — here's the first one (1h window, errors + kvmiss):
```
org:"acme" AND model:"zenith-gen-xl" AND route:"/v1/generate" AND region:"ap-sg" AND status:[500 TO 599] AND kv_cache_miss:true
| sort @timestamp desc
| fields @timestamp, request_id, latency_ms, status, model_version
```
ben: Looks good. Suggested saved-search name: `ap-sg_zenith-genxl_5xx_kvmiss_1h`. I'll create it under Observability > Saved Queries > eng-sre.
amira: Can we also hook a lightweight alert to avoid noise? Something like p95 latency > 400ms + errors > 1% over 5m before paginating.
ben: Agree on not firing on tiny blips. Plan: create a pulse alert that triggers only when both conditions hold for 5m, route to #oncall at low urgency (page after escalation). I'll add the alert and link it to the saved search.
morgan: I added a short runbook note and a snippet to ops/log-searches in PR #342 (ops/log-searches/PR-342). PR includes how to run locally and a dashboard link.
chris: I pushed the saved search in Console and named it `ap-sg_zenith-genxl_5xx_kvmiss_1h`. Console link: https://console.redwood.ai/observability/saved-searches/abcd1234 (public to org). I also added a description: "1h hunt for 5xx + KV cache misses on AP-SG generate route — use when investigating recent quality regressions or kv-cache rollout checks."
amira: Perfect — can you also pin the console link in #oncall and add to the oncall playbook?
ops-bot: Saved search created by ben and added to folder eng-sre/Oncall (id: abcd1234).
ben: Done — pinned in #oncall and updated the playbook with the link.
amira: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
chris: If you have more variants (embeddings/low-latency regressions) drop them here and I'll batch-create saved searches with the naming convention.
morgan: FYI I also added a short dashboard tile for p95 by route in the AP-SG region — link included in the PR.
amira: Great, closing this.
